BiblicalUsage: Jishai is Jesse, David's father. In Ruth 4:17, he is the father of Jesse. The fuller story is told on the Jesse, Father of David profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: What grips me is that Jesse is named at all, which tells me God sees individuals, not only crowds.
